args:
set -euo pipefail

while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "1790467279" ]; do sleep 0.2; done
export HF_HOME=/tmp/hf HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
cache=/tmp/hf/hub/models--Qwen--Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct
mkdir -p "$cache/snapshots" "$cache/refs"
ln -s /model/tokenizer "$cache/snapshots/nix"
printf nix > "$cache/refs/main"
dataset=/shared/aiperf/static-qwen2.5-0.5b/isl4000-claude-sonnet-raw.jsonl
test -s "$dataset"
exec aiperf profile --url "http://dynamo-pd-agw-generic:8080/v1/chat/completions" \
  --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct \
  --tokenizer Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct \
  --endpoint-type chat --streaming --use-server-token-count \
  --use-legacy-max-tokens --custom-dataset-type raw_payload \
  --input-file "$dataset" --random-seed 42 \
  --concurrency 128 --benchmark-duration 45 \
  --export-level summary --record-processors 16 \
  --output-artifact-dir /shared/aiperf/results/nixpd-isl4000-pd-agw-generic-r92/$(JOB_COMPLETION_INDEX)
containers.name: benchmark
